[[File:Talzin-TCWs3.png|thumb|right|250px|[[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] clan mother [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]]]]
A '''clan mother''' was an elder in a [[Witches of Dathomir|Dathomiri Witch]] clan. They were the matriarchs of their clan.

[[Tenel Ka Djo|Tenel Ka's]] great-grandmother, [[Augwynne Djo]], was the clan mother for the [[Singing Mountain Clan]].
